x: by Staff Coach under 20's Joint Southern Coaching Committee, FRANK HORWILL

He and second string Robert Cookson train with Frank Horwill's squad and that uncompromising coach's tough attitude showed through as each led their races from the gun into the teeth of the blustering Basildon breeze and each ran away from the field over the last 200 metres.

Bruce Barton clipped 2 minutes for the first time in the 'half', Marlon Anderson reduced his best in the same event (his training with Frank Horwill is obviously working) and Phil Carstairs, as our 3k runner, went under 9 minutes for yet another personal record.

Coe, while Frank Horwill was busy on the mike keeping everyone informed about recent form and best times. The weather was mild, the track was damp and the sun even broke through the January clouds for a few minutes.
